title: Vibe Coding for Entrepreneurs: 10 App Ideas You Can Ship in a Weekend
summary: 10 app ideas entrepreneurs can ship with AI this weekend. Exact prompts, time estimates. No Supabase, no Vercel config. Database, auth, and hosting included.
body_markdown: No. Vibe coding tools are designed specifically for non-technical founders — you describe what you want in plain language and the AI builds the working app. The most effective prompts are detailed and specific. "A booking tool for a coaching business with three service types and email confirmations" outperforms "a booking app" every time. If you want to learn the broader approach,[vibe coding for non-technical founders](https://blink.new/blog/vibe-coding-for-non-technical-founders) covers the full methodology.
